items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 146:1
items.html: When Ima clothes in ZON, in order to give Mochin to Beriah, the Nukva of ZA is considered the outer garment of Ima, through whom she bestows the Mochin to Beriah. For the world of Beriah cannot receive except from the Nukva of ZA, for she is its upper one. (Item 35).
